entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-08-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Local function capture list shouldn't include parameter default values #84988
  • Default value of a struct type should give nullable initial state to some field-backed properties #84987
  • BrokeredServiceProxy should cache proxies #84986
  • [EnC] Optimize EnC document analysis #84985
    Backlog
  • Language server test hangs on Linux due to exception thrown by FBA #84984
  • Publish reuses stale ReadyToRun output after RuntimeFrameworkVersion changes, so the app ships precompiled code the bundled runtime refuses #84979
  • Issue when renaming interface with "Finalize" method (C#) #84976

Closed

  • NullableWalker NullReferenceException (TypeSymbolExtensions.IsInterfaceType) analyzing a local function in an MSBuildWorkspace-loaded compilation — regression 5.3.0 → 5.6.0 #84398
    18.10

  • Omit parameter default values from local function capture lists #84989

    Community

    VSCode
  • [test-only-change] Record existing accessor parsing behavior #84981
    Community
  • Add fast IDE inner-loop validation slices #84980

    Community
  • Use .NET Core in test-rebuild.ps1 #84977
